places.fn: Family-owned since 1960 (I LOVE NY); Time Out says two brothers from Naples founded it in 1960. The year it moved to this address isn't stated.

places.note: German bar and restaurant in an old South Shore inn, with a mahogany bar that it dates to 1890.
places.fn: Claims roots around 1855, when Nicolas Killmeyer bought the property. Per its own history, the family later added an upstairs hotel and a mahogany bar commissioned in 1890, and a local brewery supplied its beer by 1907. It was renamed the Century Inn in the 1950s and became Killmeyer's Old Bavaria Inn in 1995. The city inspection record gives the address as 4256.
